input_constraints: Signature-verified Xbox roster or franchise save; direct containers bounded to 32 MiB / 4096 members. Current disc ROST version 17 or 18; save arena 0 or 1.
Names matched within pools, disambiguated by play-by-play ID, star tag and team membership. Renames need unique play-by-play ID plus unchanged birth bits. Ambiguous identities are skipped.
Added players require an unnamed, unowned NFL slot with no history, photo or play-by-play ID and enough fixed name space. Draft slots, templates and existing free agents are not free slots.
Names never truncate; unknown bits and disc identity tags stay with the target. Reserve moves, IR ownership, season state and history cannot travel through roster edits.
Pooled and retail position schemes cannot mix. Team pointer prefix stays at 65; combined reserve capacity and the existing minimum rule are enforced by replay.
Export is source-specific; regenerate after changing the source disc. No automatic Build preset, disc growth or executable patch.
portme: Apply the protected Rosters/allowlist/runtime/registry handoff; complete Noah's played witness list.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute the generated game executable or disc.
